[5:59PM] #CBDMarina #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic all the way from UBA roundabout and NNPC filling station. towards Cathedral church Inward Nitel intersection is good.
Movement from State House towards McWen bridge and connecting force road is also good.

Smooth movement is observed from Zone 2 underneath bridge towards Flag Staff House connecting McWen bridge.
Movement from Onikan roundabout by TBS onward Water Board connecting Nitel intersection is steady. 

Traffic on the stretch of Broad Street right from General Hospital towards Tinubu Square connecting Abibu oki Street Is good. Balogun junction inward Apongbon is experiencing slow movement.
The entirety of IGbosere road and Catholic mission Street connecting Ganiu Smith Street has good vehicular movement. 

Our personnel well position and managing traffic situation, and there are no impediments anywhere in these areas. 

#FollowLASTMA
